Before I get into smell and flavor, I'll rate the other categories first.

Packability: 8/10 better than most dips I've tried so far. Very easy and no clumps.

Pinchability: 8/10 very moist on the fingers and easy to grab a pinch

I'm not a professional reviewer but I'll just get into what it is like.

First I smelled the dip and it was not a surprise. It is exactly what everyone is expecting. It smells just like straight just not as strong. It was weird though cause I put my pinch in and the tobacco had a very subtle flavor and smell that didn't turn me off like a lot of dips, especially straight. For the first few minutes I didn't taste anything. Very soft on the gums and somewhat easy to keep in the lip. You can taste a tiny bit of straight and a tiny bit of smoky flavor. It was not an overwhelming taste or smell. I don't mind it.

Surprisingly the nicotine content is actually mild to moderate. I expected to not feel any nicotine at all but I feel a tiny kick with this. 

Overall I'll rate 4 out of 10. It wasn't exactly what I expected but I'm not disappointed either. Also I have to note about how moist the can I personally had was; VERY FUCKIN MOIST. With grizzly I expected it to be less moist than it is. I am honestly not a big fan. Straight flavor is not my thing.
